 rows=d['"'"'user_outcomes'"'"'][arm];s=d['"'"'arms'"'"'][arm]
 for k in ['"'"'impressions'"'"','"'"'clicks'"'"','"'"'purchases'"'"','"'"'explorations'"'"']: assert sum(r[k] for r in rows)==s[k]
 assert s['"'"'ctr'"'"']==s['"'"'clicks'"'"']/s['"'"'impressions'"'"'] and s['"'"'cvr'"'"']==s['"'"'purchases'"'"']/s['"'"'impressions'"'"']

for n,k in [('"'"'ctr'"'"','"'"'clicks'"'"'),('"'"'cvr'"'"','"'"'purchases'"'"')]: assert d['"'"'inference'"'"'][n]==clustered_rate(d['"'"'user_outcomes'"'"']['"'"'control'"'"'],d['"'"'user_outcomes'"'"']['"'"'treatment'"'"'],k,'"'"'impressions'"'"')
